title: Anatomy of a prompt
summary: A good prompt says who it's for, what you want and what shape the answer takes.
bad_prompt: Help me study for my exam.
good_prompt: I'm a first-year engineering student with a physics exam in 3 days. Make a 3-day study plan, 90 minutes per day, covering Newton's laws and friction. Give it as a table.
takeaway: Give context, a task and a format. Then check the answer.
